svg.title: Deadband
svg.desc: Animated. A graph of robot speed against the stick reading, from full left to full right. A shaded band around center, from -0.1 to 0.1, is the deadband: there the speed line lies flat at zero. Outside it the line starts from zero at the band's edge and climbs to full speed at full stick. Below, a stick knob slides along the same scale, and a robot sits on a floor line. The knob wiggles a little inside the band and the robot does not move; it is pushed right and the robot drives right; it rests a little off center and the robot stays still; it is pushed left and the robot drives back. Peashooter ignores 0.1, Black team 0.08.
svg.text: Deadband: small stick movements count as zero
So a stick that doesn't quite center can't drive the robot by itself.
Peashooter ignores 0.1, Black team 0.08. Too small and a drifting
stick creeps the robot; too big and the driver must push further.
